results.title: LeBron James’ Redemption Goes to Waste as Tyrese Maxey, Nick Nurse Reveal 76ers’ Biggest Problem After Blowout Loss
results.description: For the first time in his Philadelphia 76ers career, LeBron James scored at least 20 points in three straight games. However, the four-time NBA champion’s effort fell short as the Sixers lost 128-111 to the Portland Trail Blazers.
